caption: The drawing features a single blue drinking vessel, likely made of glass, positioned centrally against an off-white or cream-colored background. The vessel has a rounded body with a slightly flared rim, and rests on a short, circular base. The rim at the top is decorated with horizontal ribbing or grooves. Along the body, there are raised decorative elements resembling loops or handles; these are positioned symmetrically on opposite sides of the cup. The entire object is rendered in varying shades of blue, with lighter and darker areas indicating reflections and inner transparency of the glass. The surface of the vessel displays subtle, irregular, wavy patterns and highlights that suggest its reflective nature and the way light interacts with the glass material. The background is empty and plain, drawing attention exclusively to the vessel.
title: Glass Bowl
